preconditions.description: The number of rows and columns must be between 1 and 2000.
The starting cell coordinates must be within the maze dimensions.
The maximum allowed number of movements to the left and right must be non-negative.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in maze)
preconditions.description: Each row of the maze must have the same number of columns.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in ['.', '*'] for row in maze for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the maze must be either '.' (free) or '*' (obstacle).
The starting cell must be a free cell.

postconditions.description: The number of reachable cells must be between 0 and the total number of cells in the maze.

postconditions.expression: result == len([cell for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if is_reachable(i, j)])
postconditions.description: The result must be equal to the count of cells that are reachable from the starting cell.
